title.narrative: Improvement of Industrial Energy Efficiency in Myanmar

description.narrative: To promote sustained GHG emissions reduction in the Myanmar industry by improving policy and regulatory frameworks and institutional capacity building for industrial EE and the implementation of energy management systems (EnMS) based on ISO 50 001, and optimization of energy systems in industry. The project is designed with three inter-linked substantive components to maximize the impact of the offered technical assistance on improving energy efficiency within Myanmar industry.
